input:
CURRENT SCENE:
他的妈妈觉得在墓地玩儿，害得，所以他们搬家。搬家对孟子有好的影响，他才五岁，可是每天不是写字就是帮妈妈的工作。

ITEMS:

[I44] 他的妈妈【觉得在墓地】玩儿   correction: 觉得在墓地 → 在墓地觉得   strength: error
  checker's note: 在 + Place comes before the action: 在Place + V.
  rule card (location_with_zai, Grammar): Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <place> is the location, so use 在+Place before the action.  Her terms: 在+Place, 在Place住, 住在+Place, 在Place + V., 在Place V1.着V2
  her past correction: 他的妈妈[不想跟他的朋友去墓地→不想让他跟朋友去墓地] — her note: otherwise it means his mother didn’t want to go with his friend to the graveyard.
  her past correction: 妈妈认为他们[拿东西→拿了墓地的东西] — her note: “东西” is too general and vague
  her past correction: 而是她觉得墓地[不合适→不适合]孩子们玩

[I45] 【害得】   correction: 害得 → 不好   strength: error
  checker's note: 害得 needs a result complement; 不好 fits the meaning.
  rule card (haide_harmful_result, Vocabulary): Use 害得 + N/sb. + harmful result (or a harmful clause). The result must be genuinely harmful: neutral events such as 搬家 or 玩儿, and mild feelings such as 不高兴, do not fit after 害得.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: after 害得 + <person/noun>, use a genuinely harmful result; <neutral or mild result> is not harmful enough.  Her terms: 害得 + N/sb. + Harmful result, 害得+Sb.+V., 害得 + clause (harmful result)
  her past correction: [害得→让]她很不高兴 — her note: 害得 + harmful result，不高兴is not that “harmful”
  her past correction: ⟦害得他不高兴⟧ — her note: 害得 + harmful result, “不高兴” is not that “harmful”
  her past correction: 害得对孟子[有→受到了]不好的影响 — her note: 害得+Sb.+V.

[I46] 害得【，所以】他们搬家   correction: ，所以 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  rule card (cause_result_soyi, Coherence: connectors): Use 所以 only when the clause before it gives the cause/reason and the clause after it is the result. If there is no cause-result relationship, delete 所以 or use a connector such as 这样, 后来, or 结果 when appropriate.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the following event is not a result of the preceding clause, so 所以 is not appropriate; use <connector> / delete it.  Her terms: 这样, 结果, 后来
  her past correction: 所以[他们→我们]要搬家 — her note: in quoted speech
  her past correction: [+所以]他们常常搬家 — her note: 无聊？add所以
  her past correction: 所以他们[再搬家→又搬家了] — her note: 又for something already occurred

[I47] 可是每天不是写字就是帮妈妈【的】工作   correction: 的 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: 帮妈妈工作 does not take 的 here.
  rule card (no_le_routine_state, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): For a routine, habit, repeated condition, or state, use zero particle: do not add 了completed. This is especially true with words such as 老是, 常常, and 从早到晚.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: this describes a routine/habit or repeated condition, so use no 了 (no了for routine/habit).  Her terms: no了for routine/habit, no了for habit/routine, 看look vs.看到see, no了
  her past correction: 妈妈老是工作[-了] — her note: no了for routine/habit
  her past correction: 孟子的妈妈每天从早到晚[-做]工作
  her past correction: [妈妈→孟母]老是工作了 — her note: “妈妈” here is ambiguous

items.explanation: 在墓地 is the location of 玩儿, so put it before that action: 觉得在墓地玩儿.
害得 needs 害得 + N/sb. + Harmful result. Here, 不好 expresses the meaning more naturally.
It would be more natural to delete 所以 here, because the preceding words do not clearly give the cause of 搬家.
Use 帮妈妈工作 without 的. Here, 工作 is the action you help your mother do.
